defs.def: a type of literature that describes imaginary people and events, not real ones 小说

ex.s: Around the world, kids are using imagination in ways that were once only found in science fiction.
ex.t: 在世界各地，孩子们正以曾经只在科幻小说中才能找到的方式运用想象力。

ex.s: One where I kind of knew what was going to happen, historical fiction.
ex.t: 那种我大概知道会发生什么的历史小说。

ex.s: Many works of fiction appeared without the names of the authors, often with something like “By a lady.”Novels, for the most part, were looked upon as silly, immoral, or just plain bad.
ex.t: 许多小说作品没有署作者的名字，通常写着"一位女士所著"。小说在大多数情况下被视为愚蠢、不道德或简直糟糕透顶的东西。

defs.def: a thing that is invented or imagined and is not true 虚构的事；假想之物

ex.s: However, new research suggests that the story may be fiction instead of fact.
ex.t: 然而，新的研究表明这个故事可能是虚构的而不是事实。

ex.s: Often called the “Father of science fiction”.
ex.t: 常被称为科幻小说之父。

ex.s: The scene you set at the beginning of your writing — whether it is fiction or non-fiction — will engage your readers and help set the right atmosphere for the remainder of your writing.
ex.t: 你在写作开头设定的场景——无论是虚构还是非虚构——将吸引读者，并帮助为余下的内容营造正确的氛围。

ex.s: Background information The Day After Tomorrow is a 2004 American science-fiction disaster film.
ex.t: 背景信息：《后天》是一部2004年的美国科幻灾难片。

ex.s: Background information 2015 American science-fiction film The Martian, directed by Ridley Scott and starring Matt Damon, is based on Andy Weir’s 2011 novel of the same name.
ex.t: 背景信息：2015年美国科幻电影《火星救援》，由雷德利·斯科特执导，马特·达蒙主演，改编自安迪·威尔2011年的同名小说。
